description: This file defines the XSeriesElements class which represents a collection of values in an XSeries within the MigraDoc Document Object Model for charting. It provides methods to add values and serialize the collection.

classes.name: XSeriesElements
classes.description: Represents a collection of values in an XSeries for charting, allowing addition of values, nulls, and serialization.

classes.name: XSeriesElements.XSeriesElementsValues
classes.description: Holds internal nullable values associated with the XSeriesElements class.

methods.name: XSeriesElements
methods.description: Constructor initializing the collection with a new XSeriesElementsValues instance.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the XSeriesElements collection.

methods.name: AddBlank
methods.description: Adds a null value to the XSeries collection.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new XValue with the specified string value to the collection.

methods.name: Add (params string[])
methods.description: Adds multiple string values to the collection.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the collection into a DDL format using the provided serializer.

methods.name: Meta
methods.description: Returns the meta object describing this collection.

methods.name: Values
methods.description: Provides access to the internal nullable values of the collection.
